incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: HIGH - Rate limiter anomaly detected for multiple tenants (unexpected 429 surge). PD key: PD-4219. Primary signal: rate-limiter error-rate spike > 5x baseline. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings

PagerDuty: PagerDuty notification: Incident PD-4219 fired, escalation policy: infra-oncall.

irene (oncall): Acked PD-4219. I'm on it. Quick summary pls — is this customer-facing 429s or internal backpressure?

devon (infra): Seeing a cluster-wide limiter metric blip. Token-drop metric jumped at 2026-11-01T14:02:34Z. Early hypothesis: quota-mapper returning null for some tenants, fallback treats as zero -> immediate throttle.

samir (eng-runtime): Copy. I'm pulling logs from the quota-mapper service. Also checking last deploys to mapper and limiter; there was a small deploy 14:00 today that touched mapping normalization.

kevin (backend): Pasting the error snippets I'm seeing from gateway logs:
```
ERROR limiter: applyQuota tenant=acme-corp err="quota not found (key=null)" route=/v1/generate request_id=01FJ2Z...
WARN runtime: fallback to global-ratecap tenant=null
```

irene (oncall): So tenant IDs are dropping to null. Customer impact: Hana, can you surface which customers hit 429s so we can prioritize?

hana (customer-ops): On it — initial list: acme-corp, globex, two smaller tenants. Acme reported degraded latency and some 429s starting ~14:02. Reached out to account owner for acme.

devon (infra): Mitigation proposal: flip the limiter into permissive mode for the problematic route(s) to bypass strict quota enforcement for 10m while we fix mapping. Steps: set `limiter.mode=permissive` on the gateway via rollout flag, then monitor 429 rate. Pros: immediate customer relief. Cons: risk higher token consumption.

irene (oncall): Do it. Prioritize customer availability. Please post the exact commands and I'll approve.

devon (infra): Running: `kubectl -n gateway set env deployment/gw --env=LIMITER_MODE=permissive --record` then `sh /ops/flags/rollout.sh gateway 60s`

incident-bot: Deploy bot: Rollout started for gateway flags by devon.

kevin (backend): While that goes, I found the mapping diff in the 14:00 mapper deploy: a change normalized tenant IDs by trimming `.` suffixes but a bug introduced when tenant header is missing — code returns `None` instead of using downstream header. Diff: `if not tenant_id: return None` (bad). I'll revert the mapping commit.

samir (eng-runtime): Can you revert? I can hotfix the mapper to default to header value or throw explicit error so limiter treats as unauthenticated rather than null->zero.

kevin (backend): Creating PR to revert: `revert: normalize-tenant-suffix` -> merge now?

irene (oncall): Approve merge and request expedited deploy. Keep permissive mode during rollback. Hana, confirm customers being notified.

hana (customer-ops): Notifying affected accounts now: message queued to acme and globex support threads. Mentioned we're mitigating and will follow up with timeline.

PagerDuty: Pager acknowledged by irene (oncall).

devon (infra): Gateway flag rolled out (permissive) across 3 regions. 429s for acme dropped to near zero within 90s. CPU/tokens spiked ~15% but within reserve.

kevin (backend): Revert PR merged and deploying to mapper canary (one pod) for quick verification. Diff reverted and added guard: `if tenant_id is None: log.warn(...) ; return header_fallback`

samir (eng-runtime): Canary logs look clean, tenant ids restored for requests through canary. Rolling to primary.

irene (oncall): Once mapper is rolled and mapping stable, we'll switch limiter back to enforcing but with elevated quotas for affected tenants for 30m to avoid immediate throttles. Schedule that?

devon (infra): Command to re-enable enforcement: `kubectl -n gateway set env deployment/gw --env=LIMITER_MODE=enforcing --record` then `sh /ops/quotas/increase.sh --tenant acme-corp --delta 2x --duration 30m` (repeat for globex). Executing now.

incident-bot: Note: automation created incident ticket INC-2026-4219 in Jira for postmortem.

hana (customer-ops): Customers notified: acme accepted temporary workaround, will monitor. No immediate escalations.

devon (infra): Enforcement re-enabled. 429s remain low. Monitoring: error-rate back to baseline.

irene (oncall): Continuing to watch for 15m. Thanks team. I'll hand this to samir for final wrap and postmortem. Samir, take over.

samir (eng-runtime): Taking ownership. Creating follow-up tasks: (1) postmortem with timeline and root cause (mapper normalization bug), (2) add unit tests for tenant header fallback, (3) improve alerting to detect sudden tenant-null rates earlier, (4) add canary gating on mapper deploys.

hana (customer-ops): Marking impacted accounts and scheduling follow-up comms after postmortem.

irene (oncall): Marking PD incident resolved. Closing chat thread in 30m unless any regressions. Great job. :clap:

incident-bot: Incident PD-4219 status: resolved by irene (oncall). Postmortem ticket: INC-2026-4219-PM created.

kevin (backend): Note for postmortem: root cause flag: `normalize-tenant-suffix` logic returns null when header missing. Fix: explicit fallback and a defensive test.

samir (eng-runtime): Will author postmortem draft and tag eng/runtime, infra, customer-ops.

hana (customer-ops): Adding affected tenant list to the postmortem.

irene (oncall): Closing thread. If anything pops, ping PD.
